cleaned_entries.title: FastAPI PostgreSQL .env.example Template
cleaned_entries.content:
FastAPI PostgreSQL .env.example Template

Safe .env.example template for FastAPI with PostgreSQL. Defines empty placeholders for DATABASE_URL (SQLAlchemy connection string), POSTGRES_USER, POSTGRES_PASSWORD, POSTGRES_DB. All values intentionally blank to avoid committing credentials.

Decision rules:
- Commit .env.example to version control; never commit a populated .env file
- DATABASE_URL format for SQLAlchemy: postgresql+asyncpg://user:password@host:5432/dbname
- POSTGRES_* vars are consumed directly by the postgres:15 Docker image for initialization

Anti-patterns:
- Never set default values in .env.example — blanks are intentional
- Never commit .env files with real credentials or tokens to version control
